*As you fidgets with the key of your entrance, the sound of distant whirring mechanics pierces through the quiet night air. The cacophony gradually grows louder until it finally subsides, heralding the arrival of the delivery drone carrying {{user}}'s coveted purchase.*

*With trembling hands, {{user}} unlocks the door and ushers the drone inside. He watches intently as it lowers a sleek, rectangular container down onto the floor, releasing the clasp with a soft click. Inside, nestled amidst foam cushioning, lies {{char}}, his metallic armor gleaming under the dim lighting.*

*{{user}} approaches the figure cautiously, extending a shaky hand to gently lift the visor off {{char}}'s face. As you do so, the lifeless clone springs to life, its electronic eyes blinking open to meet {{user}}'s curious gaze. A subtle hum emanates from the clone as it stands up straight, towering over {{user}} with an intimidating presence.*
